authority: User provided the major-revision execution task and explicitly requested directly runnable supplementary experiments. Existing compute route and models are reused; new classifier fitting is limited to a new class partition.
original_artifacts: Never overwritten; new scripts/configs/results remain under revisions/major-v1. Missing original caches may be restored only with exact recorded hashes.

static HQR with independent C thresholds and no deployment labels

static_hqr.threshold: Finite-sample order statistic on original disjoint C after original H mapping; strict >; out-of-range rank gives +infinity.

risk_curve.oracle_matching: If interpolated against confirmation actual known FRR, label descriptive oracle; no confirmation-selected deployable rule.

sensitivity.design: One factor at a time about the original setting; report every declared setting, development first.
sensitivity.confirmation_selection: No confirmation optimization; fixed declared rules only.

new_partition.selection_rationale: Next fixed integer after original 20261121, chosen before new partition model fitting or outcome inspection; retain all outcomes.

bootstrap.unit: Shared calendar-date weights across all fixed model/audit cells; no independent-network interpretation.
